records.text: sasay ahuan a daali aidi siw?

senses.en: Why are you there at night time?
What shall we do with this?

senses.zh: 母親為什麼打她的小孩？
senses.en: Why did the mother beat her child?
What to do? How to do it?

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.269–270，sasay 條下派生詞

records.text: sasayen miba rakihan imini rezaw aku, ini mausay mukukusa?

senses.zh: 我只抱著這嬰孩而不工作怎麼辦？
senses.en: What shall I do if I have to hold this baby and can not work?
I don't know what to say.
